pages.text: In the dump, unlike other places, you always need to be careful, or you might fall into an acid pit. I learned about it by accident when I dropped a bucket with my tools into it. Right before my eyes, all my metal tools melted, but surprisingly, the fragile bucket remained intact. It seems I can use it for processing melted-down scrap metal.
Attaching a photo of one such lake.
I've tried to write down as many recipes as possible—both so I don't forget and to help the reader of this diary, if anyone ever finds it and wants to read it.
